samples.title: Ribbon runs: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
line is text. A character is one letter, digit, space, or punctuation mark. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", the result list is [2, 1, 2].

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete ribbonRunsProofStrip(line, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
